value.reply: Yes, but it will cost more. Your room is ₹10,000/day, which is above your ₹5,000 limit. This means other hospital charges like doctor fees and surgery will be paid at only 50%. You will also pay 10% of the final bill. The best way to save is to ask the hospital to move you to a room within ₹5,000/day. This is the single biggest saving. To check your full claim, I need to know who is in the hospital and whether the admission was an emergency or planned.
